node.statement: Because g and gbar are C^1 and equal pointwise on B^{icalH}_{2delta}(0), Dg_U(0) = Dgbar_U(0) for every U. Applying lem-stage1-maurer-cartan-trivialization under the guard in node 1.3.1, and substituting these derivative equalities, yields every tangent formula and the global C^1 omega formula for g, with distortion at most 1 + Cbar*epsilon_r; the identities omega_{cU}(cZ)=omega_U(Z) and omega_U(iU)=iJ are unchanged because omega is the same displayed map.
